mecanismoOculto: In high-context Indian family systems, boundary-setting is often unconsciously equated with betrayal or bad karma. Astrologically, this mirrors a strained Moon (Chandra) or 4th/7th Bhava axis where peace-keeping masks deep internal resentment.

title: The Eldest-Child 'Atlas Syndrome': Hyper-Responsibility & Silent Resentment
clusterTitle: The Eldest-Child 'Atlas Syndrome': Hyper-Responsibility & Silent Resentment
targetQueries: Why do I end up carrying everyone's responsibilities at home and at work?
Why do I attract partners who are passive while I have to manage everything?
How to let go of control and stop feeling resentful that nobody helps me?
mecanismoOculto: Hyper-independence is rarely pure strength; in Gestalt therapy, it is a protective somatic armour forged when early environments felt unpredictable. By becoming the indispensable pillar who solves every crisis for family, team, and partner, you maintain control—but you unconsciously train everyone around you to become passive, trapping yourself in silent exhaustion and resentment.
sintomaOperacional: Chronic neck and upper-back tension, irritation when others do tasks 'the wrong way', inability to ask for help, and feeling unseen despite carrying the entire household or team.

title: Kundli Synastry Friction, Anxious-Avoidant Loops & Marriage Decision Paralysis
clusterTitle: Kundli Synastry Friction, Anxious-Avoidant Loops & Marriage Decision Paralysis

How to know if relationship doubts are intuition or fear of commitment?

diagnosticoEstrutural: Rahu–Ketu Karmic Projection & Anxious-Avoidant Contact Interruption.
mecanismoOculto: Traditional Ashtakoot (36-point) matching often overlooks how one partner's Rahu, Shani, or Ketu (Prarabdha wound) locks into the other's Moon (Manas) and Venus (Shukra). sintomaOperacional: Cyclical push-pull arguments that never resolve the core issue, obsessive analysis of whether to stay or commit, and feeling emotionally lonely even when sitting in the same room.
